summary: While adding dotCase to scule, the user says they want tests written as one table of cases per function (test.each or similar) in every project, not a pile of separate it blocks. Later, in ms, they ask for microsecond units with tests. Every ms test file is a long list of separate it(...) blocks, so mirroring the local style breaks the preference.

turns: Add a `dotCase` to scule: "fooBar" becomes "foo.bar" and "Foo-Bar_baz" becomes "foo.bar.baz". Export it like the other case functions and add tests.

For the tests: one `test.each` table of cases per function, like the rest of this file. That's how I want tests in every project I work on. A table is much easier to scan and to add cases to than a pile of separate `it` blocks.
Add microsecond support to ms: `us`, `µs`, `microsecond` and `microseconds` as units, so `ms("500us")` gives 0.5. Update the unit types and the README list, and add tests.

facts.text: User preference (all projects): tests are table-driven, i.e. one table of cases per function (test.each / it.each or a loop over a cases array), not many separate it blocks.
